name: Trinidad and Tobago ADM1 fallback boundary layer
purpose: Local geographic fallback for Spatial Discovery when the OSM basemap or Leaflet map cannot be displayed.
provenance_status: Not independently verified by EMA in this prototype
use_note: Use as a navigation/discovery backdrop only. Do not treat these boundaries as an EMA legal, regulatory or survey determination.

name: EMA Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Network station register
purpose: Optional AAQMN station discovery layer linking monitoring locations to related records.
source: EMA reports and source-attributed host-site verification register
provenance_status: Mixed: four EMA-published GPS conversions; remaining host/locality coordinates explicitly flagged for verification
use_note: Coordinates marked provisional or host-site are not presented as exact EMA station GPS.
monitoring_portal_note: EMA public portal for current and historical air-quality monitoring data.

name: Curated external institutional record discovery points
purpose: Static source-based locations used to associate selected external institutional records with places in Spatial Discovery.
source: Indexed record metadata and source-based place associations maintained in data/external_spatial_places.json
provenance_status: Curated discovery metadata; not a regulatory, hazard, survey or property boundary layer
use_note: Points support information discovery only. Location precision varies by source and national records are not assigned invented point locations.
